transcript.text: The back burner on our gas hob has gone a lazy yellow colour and leaves black soot on the pan. What's wrong with it?

A lazy yellow flame with soot usually means the gas isn't mixing properly with air before it burns. This is most often caused by a burner cap that is slightly misaligned, wet after cleaning, or blocked by grease and food debris in the ports. Please switch off the gas supply to the hob (at the cooker tap) and let it cool completely. Then lift off the burner cap and base of that back burner. Check if they are dry, clean, and sitting perfectly flat when you put them back on. If they look fine but the problem persists, we can look at other causes.

I've had a look and the cap seems to be sitting properly, though there are some burnt spills around it. I should also mention that I've noticed a faint smell of gas near the hob a few times in the mornings, even when all the knobs are off.

⚠ Stop using this appliance
If you can smell gas, treat it as an emergency: don't turn any switches on or off and no naked flames. Turn the gas off at the meter if you safely can, open doors and windows, and leave if the smell is strong. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999.

candidates: Incorrect gas pressure or air shutter setting (less common) (medium)
Blocked burner ports due to food spillage (medium)

reading.symptom: back burner flame is lazy yellow and leaves black soot on the pan

plan: They asked: "What's wrong with it?" - answer that first.
The fault they reported is: "back burner flame is lazy yellow and leaves black soot on the pan". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.

hazards.clause: i should also mention that i've noticed a faint smell of gas near the hob a few times in the mornings, even when all the knobs are off
